acceptance: Regression: successfully open a requested project board, observe target, deliver normal final; no false Interrupted label after normal Stop.
Explicit interruption/crash/unfinished development stays distinguishable; no automatic Verified without appropriate current evidence.
Define consistent read-only/action-request classification and completion lifecycle in hooks/instructions/UI; audit existing misleading records conservatively without erasing history.
payload.description: User-reported confirmed repro in OpenOffice: task_6fa757412672b0a45e37d1789362f433c33bce54999cc1af372d75852c8c3478 requested opening the DIP project board. Agent opened correct OpenOffice board, confirmed visible backlog and delivered link; normal turn ended. task_get still status in_progress, no resolution/evidence, automatic checkpoint at 2026-11-05T20:32:47.957Z saying completion not asserted. src/core.js computes interrupted = status==='in_progress' && !active; src/automation.js treats Stop/SessionEnd like checkpoint+lease end. Thus UI Interrupted conflates inactive/unclosed with actual interruption, especially navigation/read-only requests where instructions say no DIP management calls. Investigate classification and trusted normal-completion evidence plus workflow instructions. Do not mass mark old records verified; distinguish verified/answered/completed-unverified/inactive/interrupted with honest evidence. Also observed app-generated suggestion prompts entering backlog; audit classification separately if related. Report requested by user in OpenOffice session 01a1a6ff-e79b-7730-8f7c-b333a5aa0d19.
